children: Injective is set to introduce tokenized stocks onchain, a release that brings equity tokenization directly to the network with INJ positioned as the powering asset for the new flow. The rollout is scheduled for the next day, placing the product launch in immediate focus for the protocol and its native token.

The structure of the release ties the new equity tokenization flow to INJ itself, making the token the asset that powers activity around tokenized stocks on the network. Because the launch lands the next day, the timing is near-term rather than distant, which is why observers are watching INJ closely around this rollout. As with any scheduled release, actual adoption of the tokenized stock product will depend on usage after launch, and the announcement itself does not confirm demand levels.
Injective will introduce a new age of tokenized stocks onchain.

title: Injective: Tokenized Stocks Onchain Launch Powered by INJ - 23 Sep 2026
